name: SmolVLA

sources.locator: model repository (weights hosted on the Hub)

relations.note: SmolVLM2 is the pretrained vision-language backbone; a flow-matching action expert added on top generates the robot actions.

summary.text: SmolVLA is a 450M-parameter open-weight vision-language-action model for robotics from Hugging Face's LeRobot project. It pairs SmolVLM2 with an action expert trained with flow matching to turn camera images, robot state and an optional instruction into continuous actions; Hugging Face says it can run on a CPU and pretrained it on community-shared LeRobot datasets.

changes.text: Adds robot state input and continuous action output, generated by a flow-matching action expert on top of the SmolVLM2 backbone.

inputModalities.note: Multi-view camera images, the robot's sensorimotor state and an optional language instruction.

notes: Not in the decided scope; added by the research step and kept after verification. Vision-language-action model for robotics from Hugging Face's LeRobot project (Hub organisation lerobot), released as the pretrained base checkpoint smolvla_base for fine-tuning; Apache 2.0 per the card metadata. Paper authors are affiliated with Hugging Face, Sorbonne University, valeo.ai and ENS Paris-Saclay (arXiv v1 submitted 2025-06-02); Hugging Face is recorded as sole developer because the blog and the model are Hugging Face releases. The vision encoder inside SmolVLM2 is Google SigLIP (cross-organisation, not recorded). Robot state input is mapped to the structured-data modality.
